Container.Name: mover
Container.Overview: Watches source folders (inotify) and moves or copies finished downloads to a target: per file, leaf folder or top-level entry, after a debounce and an optional end-of-download marker. Atomic arrival, never overwrites. Configured in /config/mover.toml; manual run: docker exec mover mover run <rule>.

Config.Name: Cache pool
Config.Description: Same path inside and out: rules use real disk paths

Config.Name: Other pool
Config.Description: Another disk or pool holding sources or targets, same path inside and out. Mount a target's parent so its temp sibling is reachable.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: mover.toml (example written on first start), copied.db, logs

Config.Name: Armed
Config.Description: 0 = every rule only logs its plan. 1 = rules act (except those with dry_run = true).
